en: Sharaf al-Din al-Muzaffar ibn Muhammad al-Tusi
ar: شرف الدين المظفر بن محمد الطوسي

description.tr: Kübik fonksiyonların maksimumlarını bularak Hayyâm'ın kübik denklemlerini genişletti — analizden yüzyıllar önce türevin örtük kullanımı || Şerefeddin'in risalesi tüm 25 tip kübik denklemi sınıflandırdı. || [Tarih notu] Rashed'in 1986 kritik edisyonu Şerefeddin'in matematiğinin devrimci karakterini ortaya çıkardı.
description.en: Extended Khayyam's cubic equations by finding maxima of cubic functions — an implicit use of the derivative centuries before calculus. Roshdi Rashed called this 'the beginning of algebraic geometry' || Sharaf al-Din's treatise classified all 25 types of cubic equations and investigated existence conditions for positive solutions. He applied the Ruffini-Horner method to approximate roots — the first known application to general polynomials. His student Kamal al-Din ibn Yunus taught Nasir al-Din al-Tusi, creating a direct lineage from Seljuk to Maragha Observatory. || [Historiographical note] Rashed's 1986 critical edition and analysis revealed the revolutionary character of Sharaf al-Din's mathematics, previously unknown to Western scholarship.
description.ar: وسّع معادلات الخيام التكعيبية — أول استخدام ضمني للمشتقة || صنّف شرف الدين جميع أنواع المعادلات المكعبة وبحث شروط وجود الحلول الموجبة. طبّق طريقة رفيني-هورنر على كثيرات الحدود العامة لأول مرة
